title: Audit repository for secrets before public visibility
description: Audit the final repository tree, ignored and untracked files relevant to publication, configuration, workflows, release artifacts, and all reachable Git history for credentials, tokens, private keys, personal data, machine-specific paths, and other sensitive material before the repository is made public. Use multiple complementary scanners and targeted manual review, record reproducible evidence, distinguish false positives, and safely remediate current-tree findings. Do not rewrite Git history, rotate credentials, or change repository visibility without explicit approval; report any historical finding that requires those actions.

comments.author: Codex
comments.message: Pre-public audit progress, fully redacted: checksum-verified Gitleaks 8.30.1 using the complete 222-rule upstream default configuration with no repository allowlists reported 0 findings in the final filesystem tree and 0 across git --all --full-history. Checksum-verified TruffleHog 3.95.9 with all detectors, recursive decoding, archive inspection, no exclusions, and no external verification reported 0 findings in the tree and history. Both scanners also reported 0 findings for all 20 materialized non-commit tree refs, the published v0.1.0 checksum-verified assets, and the checkpoint-only historical executable. Targeted regex, entropy, commit/tag metadata, deleted-file, workflow/config/docs/example, internal-host/private-IP, embedded-credential, private-key, personal-data, and absolute-path review found no credential or secret material. False positives reviewed: runtime Trello credential variable names contain no literals; SECURITY.md contact and LICENSE attribution are intentionally public; public repository URLs/names are expected; a checkpoint-only generated Windows executable embeds non-secret compiler paths whose username is already public attribution and is absent from public branch/tag release binaries. Current-tree remediation replaced one literal home path in .wtp/done/wtp-0014.json with $HOME. Durable prevention adds .gitleaks.toml, checksum-pinned CI tree/history scanning, and contributor guidance. Unix check.sh, PowerShell check.ps1, actionlint 1.7.12, JSON/WTP validation, and final rescans pass. BLOCKER: commits a7ed7a667d52 and 7f61f95915c8, reachable from main, origin/main, and v0.1.0, expose one non-noreply author mailbox in Git metadata. The value is omitted. It does not match the explicit SECURITY.md contact and GitHub does not associate those commit authors with the repository owner. User decision required: explicitly approve that mailbox for public history, or separately authorize history rewrite plus tag/release reconciliation. No history, tag, release, visibility, credential, commit, or push mutation was performed.
